svg.title: Brutus: find the processes slowing your Mac
svg.desc: Real preview-mode terminal capture showing memory pressure, RAM, swap, SSD headroom, three individual process choices with commands, and keyboard controls. Local project names and paths are redacted.

g.text: No heavy swapping. Closing a helper is optional.
Swap 28.9 GB · SSD 17.0 GB free — LOW
